thread.title: Apple News Subscription Service Planned From Texture Acquisition

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple News Subscription Service Planned From Texture Acquisition

organizations.name: apple news subscription service planned from texture acquisition apple

text:
Apple ( AAPL ) reportedly plans to offer a news subscription service in an upgraded version of its Apple News app sometime within the next year.
X The service will come from integrating the recently acquired digital magazine app Texture into Apple News, Bloomberg reported Tuesday . Called "the Netflix ( NFLX ) of magazines," Texture gives subscribers access to over 200 magazines for a monthly fee of $9.99. Apple bought Texture last month for an undisclosed sum.
The premium news app is part of a broader effort by Apple to generate more revenue from online content and services. Its Apple Music service recently passed 40 million paying subscribers. Apple also is rumored to be planning a subscription internet video service.
Curating Journalism At the SXSW conference last month, Apple's head of services, Eddy Cue, said the Texture acquisition is part of the company's Apple News venture to curate quality journalism content from trusted sources.
 Apple shares gained 1.4% to close at 178.24 on the stock market today .
Apple's services unit generated sales of $8.47 billion in the December quarter, up 18% year over year and accounting for nearly 10% of total sales. The services unit includes Apple Music, Apple Pay, App Store, AppleCare, iCloud and other offerings.
